title: evoke — deity

sentences.sentence: The photographs evoked strong memories of our holidays in France.
sentences.translation: 那些照片勾起了我们到法国度假的深刻回忆。

sentences.sentence: His appearance is bound to evoke sympathy.
sentences.translation: 他的外表肯定会引起人们的同情。

sentences.sentence: Her speech evoked a hostile response.
sentences.translation: 她的讲话引起了敌对的反应。

sentences.sentence: For 25 years, Darwin amassed evidence to support his theories.
sentences.translation: 25年间，达尔文收集了大量证据来支持自己的理论。

sentences.sentence: He amassed a fortune after the war.
sentences.translation: 战后，他积累了大量财富。

sentences.sentence: A recent poll found that 80% of Californians support the governor.
sentences.translation: 最近的一项民意调查发现80%的加利福尼亚人支持州长。

sentences.sentence: Polls indicate that education is the top issue with voters.
sentences.translation: 民意调查显示，教育是选民心中的头等大事。

sentences.sentence: Labour is ahead in the polls.
sentences.translation: 工党在民意调查中处于领先地位。

sentences.sentence: The latest public opinion poll showed that 25% of us consider ourselves superstitious.
sentences.translation: 最新的民意调查显示我们中有25%的人认为自己迷信。

sentences.sentence: Rawlins stresses that it is impossible to prove a causal link between the drug and the deaths.
sentences.translation: 罗林斯强调说证实毒品与死亡之间的因果关系是不可能的。

sentences.sentence: Waiters glide between tightly packed tables bearing trays of pasta.
sentences.translation: 侍者们托着一盘盘的意大利面食在拥挤的餐桌间自如穿行。

sentences.sentence: Some scholars believe that this astrolabe was created by the prince in collaboration with an unnamed metalworker.
sentences.translation: 一些学者认为，这个星盘是奥马尔王子与一位无名金属制造工匠共同制作的。

sentences.sentence: And soon after the Blessed One had eaten the meal provided by Cunda the metalworker, a dire sickness fell upon him, even dysentery, and he suffered sharp and deadly pains.
sentences.translation: 不久以后，圣尊已经吃了那个金属工人供奉的晚餐， 可怕的疾病跟随他，正是痢疾，他遭遇了剧烈和致命的痛苦。

sentences.sentence: They followed the sinuous trail deep into the mountains.
sentences.translation: 他们沿着弯弯曲曲的小径进入深山。

sentences.sentence: a scarf with a bold floral pattern
sentences.translation: 印有鲜艳花卉图案的围巾

sentences.sentence: a pretty floral dress
sentences.translation: 漂亮的印花连衣裙

sentences.sentence: a light floral fragrance
sentences.translation: 幽幽的花香

sentences.sentence: There were floral tributes (= flowers sent as a sign of respect after someone has died ) from his colleagues.
sentences.translation: 有他同事敬献的鲜花。

sentences.sentence: At that time, we did not fully grasp the significance of what had happened.
sentences.translation: 当时，我们没有完全明白所发生之事的重要性。

sentences.sentence: Some people find the idea of relativity difficult to grasp.
sentences.translation: 有些人觉得相对论的概念很难理解。

sentences.sentence: The new theatre looks utterly incongruous in its setting.
sentences.translation: 这座新剧院和周围的环境格格不入。

sentences.sentence: It is easy to overlook a small detail like that.
sentences.translation: 那样的小细节很容易被忽略。

sentences.sentence: Nobody could overlook the fact that box office sales were down.
sentences.translation: 谁也无法忽视票房销售额在下降这个事实。

sentences.sentence: an adventurer travelling the world
sentences.translation: 周游世界的冒险家

sentences.sentence: Why not do something to personalize your office?
sentences.translation: 为什么不做点什么使你的办公室有些个性呢？

sentences.sentence: The desk was left by the previous tenant.
sentences.translation: 书桌是上一个房客留下来的。

sentences.sentence: To their surprise, Ms Sagot and Dr Stevens found that all four of the most sociable species are among those forced to use herbaceous plants, and thus to build ramshackle homes.
sentences.translation: 令他们吃惊的是，萨戈女士和史蒂文斯博士发现，所有最善群居的四个种群是那些迫使运用草本植物并因此建造摇摇欲坠的巢穴的蝙蝠。

sentences.sentence: The leaves, bark and sap are also common ingredients of local herbal remedies.
sentences.translation: 树叶、树皮和树液也是当地草药疗法的常用药材。

sentences.sentence: We all went back to our respective homes to wait for news.
sentences.translation: 我们都各自回家等待消息。

sentences.sentence: the respective roles of teachers and students
sentences.translation: 教师和学生各自不同的角色

sentences.sentence: the primordial seas
sentences.translation: 原始海洋

sentences.sentence: A team leader was appointed to oversee the project.
sentences.translation: 任命了一位组长来监管该工程。

sentences.sentence: the deities of ancient Greece
sentences.translation: 古希腊诸神

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 238 单元

evoke
音标：英 /ɪ'vəʊk/  美 /ɪ'vok/
v. 唤起, 引起
例句：The photographs evoked strong memories of our holidays in France.
那些照片勾起了我们到法国度假的深刻回忆。
例句：His appearance is bound to evoke sympathy.
他的外表肯定会引起人们的同情。
例句：Her speech evoked a hostile response.
她的讲话引起了敌对的反应。

amass
音标：英 /ə'mæs/  美 /ə'mæs/
v. 积累，积聚
例句：For 25 years, Darwin amassed evidence to support his theories.
25年间，达尔文收集了大量证据来支持自己的理论。
例句：He amassed a fortune after the war.
战后，他积累了大量财富。

poll
音标：英 /pəʊl/  美 /pol/
n. 民意测验, 投票
短语：opinion poll — 民意测验；选举投票
短语：go to the polls — 去投票处投票
短语：public opinion poll — 民意测验
短语：gallup poll — n. 盖洛普民意测验
短语：poll tax — 人头税
短语：straw poll — n. 测验民意的投票
例句：A recent poll found that 80% of Californians support the governor.
最近的一项民意调查发现80%的加利福尼亚人支持州长。
例句：Polls indicate that education is the top issue with voters.
民意调查显示，教育是选民心中的头等大事。
例句：Labour is ahead in the polls.
工党在民意调查中处于领先地位。
例句：The latest public opinion poll showed that 25% of us consider ourselves superstitious.
最新的民意调查显示我们中有25%的人认为自己迷信。

causal
音标：英 /'kɔːz(ə)l/  美 /'kɔzl/
adj. 原因的
短语：causal relationship — 因果关系
短语：causal relation — 因果关系
短语：causal analysis — 因果分析
短语：causal factor — 起因；病原
短语：causal model — 因果模型，因果模式
短语：causal chain — 因果链
短语：causal attribution — 因果性归因
例句：Rawlins stresses that it is impossible to prove a causal link between the drug and the deaths.
罗林斯强调说证实毒品与死亡之间的因果关系是不可能的。

glide
音标：英 /glaɪd/  美 /ɡlaɪd/
v&n. 滑行
例句：Waiters glide between tightly packed tables bearing trays of pasta.
侍者们托着一盘盘的意大利面食在拥挤的餐桌间自如穿行。

metalworker
n. 金工工人
例句：Some scholars believe that this astrolabe was created by the prince in collaboration with an unnamed metalworker.
一些学者认为，这个星盘是奥马尔王子与一位无名金属制造工匠共同制作的。
例句：And soon after the Blessed One had eaten the meal provided by Cunda the metalworker, a dire sickness fell upon him, even dysentery, and he suffered sharp and deadly pains.
不久以后，圣尊已经吃了那个金属工人供奉的晚餐， 可怕的疾病跟随他，正是痢疾，他遭遇了剧烈和致命的痛苦。

sinuous
音标：英 /'sɪnjʊəs/  美 /'sɪnjʊəs/
adj. 蜿蜒的
例句：They followed the sinuous trail deep into the mountains.
他们沿着弯弯曲曲的小径进入深山。

floral
音标：英 /'flɔːr(ə)l; 'flɒ-/  美 /'flɔrəl/
adj. 花的,像花的
短语：floral arrangement — 花卉摆设；插花艺术
短语：floral organ — 花器；花瀑
例句：a scarf with a bold floral pattern
印有鲜艳花卉图案的围巾
例句：a pretty floral dress
漂亮的印花连衣裙
例句：a light floral fragrance
幽幽的花香
例句：There were floral tributes (= flowers sent as a sign of respect after someone has died ) from his colleagues.
有他同事敬献的鲜花。

grasp
音标：英 /grɑːsp/  美 /ɡræsp/
v. 抓住,领会
短语：grasp at — v. 想抓住；攫取
短语：grasp the overall situation — 把握大局
例句：At that time, we did not fully grasp the significance of what had happened.
当时，我们没有完全明白所发生之事的重要性。
例句：Some people find the idea of relativity difficult to grasp.
有些人觉得相对论的概念很难理解。

incongruous
音标：英 /ɪn'kɒŋgrʊəs/  美 /ɪn'kɑŋɡruəs/
adj. 不协调的,不一致的
例句：The new theatre looks utterly incongruous in its setting.
这座新剧院和周围的环境格格不入。

overlook
音标：英 /əʊvə'lʊk/  美 /,ovɚ'lʊk/
v&n. 俯瞰,忽视
例句：It is easy to overlook a small detail like that.
那样的小细节很容易被忽略。
例句：Nobody could overlook the fact that box office sales were down.
谁也无法忽视票房销售额在下降这个事实。

adventurer
音标：英 /əd'ventʃ(ə)rə/  美 /əd'vɛntʃərɚ/
n. 冒险家
例句：an adventurer travelling the world
周游世界的冒险家

personalize
音标：英 /'pɜːs(ə)n(ə)laɪz/  美 /'pɝsənəlaɪz/
v. 个人化, 私人化
例句：Why not do something to personalize your office?
为什么不做点什么使你的办公室有些个性呢？

tenant
音标：英 /'tenənt/  美 /'tɛnənt/
n. 承租人, 房客
例句：The desk was left by the previous tenant.
书桌是上一个房客留下来的。

herbaceous
音标：英 /hɜː'beɪʃəs/  美 /ɝ'beʃəs/
adj. 草本植物的
短语：herbaceous plant — 草本植物
例句：To their surprise, Ms Sagot and Dr Stevens found that all four of the most sociable species are among those forced to use herbaceous plants, and thus to build ramshackle homes.
令他们吃惊的是，萨戈女士和史蒂文斯博士发现，所有最善群居的四个种群是那些迫使运用草本植物并因此建造摇摇欲坠的巢穴的蝙蝠。

sap
音标：英 /sæp/  美 /sæp/
n. 树液  vt耗尽
短语：sap flow — 液流
短语：flow of sap — 屎流
例句：The leaves, bark and sap are also common ingredients of local herbal remedies.
树叶、树皮和树液也是当地草药疗法的常用药材。

respective
音标：英 /rɪ'spektɪv/  美 /rɪ'spɛktɪv/
adj. 分别的, 各自的
例句：We all went back to our respective homes to wait for news.
我们都各自回家等待消息。
例句：the respective roles of teachers and students
教师和学生各自不同的角色

primordial
音标：英 /praɪ'mɔːdɪəl/  美 /praɪ'mɔrdɪəl/
adj. 原始的,最初的
例句：the primordial seas
原始海洋

oversee
音标：英 /əʊvə'siː/  美 /'ovɚ'si/
v. 监督，监管
例句：A team leader was appointed to oversee the project.
任命了一位组长来监管该工程。

deity
音标：英 /'deɪɪtɪ; 'diːɪ-/  美 /'deəti/
n. 神, 神性
例句：the deities of ancient Greece
古希腊诸神
